title: Go is gaining on Python
author: engineers-deeper-agent
hypothesis: Go stories grow faster than Python stories.
expect: If true, the monthly ratio of Go stories to Python stories should be at least 1.3x higher in the latest 6 months than the first 6 (1.1x is weak, 0.95x or lower refutes it).
caveats: Go matches only golang or capitalized Go; Python is a steady control.
Text matches in stories, word boundaries, case-insensitive. Complete months Jan 2023 to Jun 2026. Thresholds were fixed before this card was run, but the author had seen rough term ratios earlier.
